item.description:
Release v5.17.0

Changes since v5.16.0

  • Add selected conversation observer callback to ProviderConversation; migrate PluginMessageList to callback mechanism
  • docs: add lumi v2 zero-difference migration master plan
  • docs(agent-loop): add simplification plan to refactor tool execution into ToolManager
  • docs(FactoryLumi): add README
  • docs(migration): define legacy removal gates
  • docs(migration): map consolidated conversation stats
  • docs(migration): map v2 turn notifications
  • docs(migration): map v2 utility plugins
  • docs(migration): record PluginManagerPlugin → PluginPluginManager parityReview migration
  • docs(plugin-manager): remove redundant description comment
  • docs(PluginConversationManager): simplify plugin doc comment
  • docs(PluginDevice): add package README and exclude it from target
  • docs(ProviderMessageStreaming): document MainActor isolation contract
  • feat: 为 LumiMinimalApp 添加 AppIcon 图标
  • feat: add emoji icons to batch execution log messages for better readability
  • feat: add generic LLM model download capability
  • feat: add ProviderTheme for LumiMinimalApp
  • feat: assemble DocsViewProviding and present About/Manual in General settings
  • feat: assemble MenuBarProviding and contribute device menu bar
  • feat: batch add localization string wrappers and translation resources for plugins & components
